title: Tecsys TS7100 IRD Digital Satellite
excerpt: Receives DVB-S / S2 MPEG-2 digital signals from C / Ku band frequency transmissions. Suitable for use in professional free to air (FTA) signal reception and retransmission systems, as well as satellite TV and monitoring stations.
body:
Receives DVB-S / S2 MPEG-2 digital signals from C / Ku band frequency transmissions. Suitable for use in professional free to air (FTA) signal reception and retransmission systems, as well as satellite TV and monitoring stations.

Main Features:

Possibility of adding a custom logo on the opening screen

Password to access the IRD settings menu if required

Allows Closed Caption

RS232 interface for software upgrade
